description: React component for adding nodes in a UI, including search, categorization, and drag-and-drop functionality, with integration of Material-UI components and custom dialogs.

methods.name: a11yProps
methods.description: Generates accessibility props for tabs based on index.

methods.name: addException
methods.description: Returns nodes that are exceptions for specific categories in agent canvas.

methods.name: fuzzyScore
methods.description: Calculates a fuzzy matching score between search term and text for relevance ranking.

methods.name: scoreAndSortNodes
methods.description: Scores nodes based on fuzzy search relevance and sorts them.

methods.name: getSearchedNodes
methods.description: Filters and sorts nodes based on search value and context.

methods.name: filterSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, filters nodes, and updates view.

methods.name: groupByTags
methods.description: Groups nodes based on selected tab/tag.

methods.name: groupByCategory
methods.description: Groups nodes into categories for display, with filtering based on context.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the add nodes popper.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns image URL based on selected tab.

methods.name: renderIcon
methods.description: Renders icon for a node if available.

methods.name: handleOpenDialog
methods.description: Opens the dialog to generate a new agent flow.

methods.name: handleCloseDialog
methods.description: Closes the agent flow generation dialog.

methods.name: handleConfirmDialog
methods.description: Confirms agent flow generation and triggers callback.
